verdicts.reason: Every part is confirmed in the manual and the code, including at tag 20221114.0. The fallback test is ceil(dimension / tile size) <= 1, so 600 pixels or fewer in either dimension runs fixed, counted in pixels of the output grid. Two precision notes: the Sentinel-2 default dark spectrum is an intercept fit over the lowest 200 pixels, not the single darkest pixel, and 600 pixels is 6 km only at the default 10 m output grid.
verdicts.suggested_correction: Optional wording: 'from the darkest pixels (an intercept fit over the lowest 200 pixels by default) of the processed region or tile'. State the fallback in km as well as pixels, 6 km at 10 m with 600 pixels and 6 km at 20 m with 300 pixels.

verdicts.reason: The mechanism is right: a clip replaces the 6 km tiled estimate with one fixed estimate from the clip window, or with a tile grid anchored to the clip corner. The wording misleads, because 300 and 600 pixels are both 6 km on their own grids (20 m and 10 m), so F-30's contrast suggests a tile-size gap that does not exist. 'A different product' is also too strong, because a whole-tile run with USGS settings reproduces the estimation window, while the release and interpolation code are a second source of difference. The size of the difference is unmeasured, and the developer expects tiled and per-target results to be close.
verdicts.suggested_correction: Reword F-30 and practice P15 in km: 'USGS tiles are 6 km (300 pixels at 20 m). A clip of 6 km or less in either dimension runs one fixed estimate, and a larger clip tiles from its own corner, so the aerosol differs from the whole-tile run. A whole-tile run with the USGS settings uses the same window. Any run on a release after 20221114.0 also differs in tiled interpolation. The size of the difference is unmeasured, probe T9.' Replace 'is a different product' with 'is not guaranteed to match the scene it fills'. Candidate question 5 can close, since the version is 20221114.0 and the settings files are on disk.

limitations: No ACOLITE code was executed. Every source was read as text. git fetch, curl and pdftotext were used only to download and parse. Saved copies are under /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-arik-github-sentinel2-pipeline-development/762b3e6f-e4f2-4a11-be66-876d07ee3350/scratchpad/validation/acolite (repo at commit ca477dd, manual PDF, forum pages, registry and documentation pages, Earth Search and EODC STAC metadata).

Fetched fresh on 2026-10-13: GitHub raw files at ca477dd and tag 20221114.0, the GitHub tag tree, the manual PDF (67 pages, release 20260421.0), three forum threads, the AWS registry, the Sinergise L1C readme, CDSE documentation, the USGS metadata XML, and JSON metadata from the Earth Search API and the EODC STAC API. No S3 bucket and no imagery were touched. Earth Search and EODC calls returned collection and item metadata only.
PDF quotes come from pdftotext output with line breaks joined, and hyphenated line breaks were avoided. Page numbers are PDF page indexes, found by searching each page.

V-ACO-2 'no reader for AWS objects' is an absence claim. It rests on a text search of the tree at one commit (boto, s3://, amazonaws, earth-search, vsis3, sentinel-s2) plus a reading of safe_test.py. The AWS-layout rebuild problem is an inference from the code, not a run.
The poster 'the developer account' is identified as the developer from the signature, the code headers by QV, and the matching 2025-12-08 change. The forum page does not label the role.

V-ACO-5 is a judgment on an estimate. Run time, peak memory, disk per scene, and whether GDAL reads only the JPEG 2000 tiles a clip needs are unmeasured, so no reviewer can confirm a medium or high rating from documents alone. The 2022-era code on a current GDAL and numpy stack was not checked.
I did not verify the 81 percent figure in F-29 (measurement finding 28). The ratio 15,744 of 19,336 scenes in aqr-coverage.json is consistent with it.

The Zarr route of release 20260421.0 and the legacy Google Cloud helper in acolite/gem/scene_download.py (gs://gcp-public-data-sentinel-2) are leads. Coverage, stability, payer terms and fit with release 20221114.0 were not checked.
CDSE 'free to registered users' rests on the quota page, which speaks of user accounts and a free tier. Offline (deferred) products on CDSE and real throughput were not tested.
Verdict 'validated' means the cited sources support the claim as worded, with the notes given. It does not mean the engineering conclusions drawn downstream hold.
